interface.shortDescription: Unified local routing, memory, context, quality, and optional Control Center telemetry.
interface.longDescription: RouteCraft for Codex is the unified Local Runtime for Sol-led routing, bounded companion-agent delegation, hooks, local project continuity, private reusable decisions, context compilation, diagnostics, benchmark execution, and safe security checks. Core behavior remains fully supported without the separately versioned RouteCraft Control Center Add-on. When explicitly enabled, the privacy-filtered Collector sends only versioned aggregate telemetry; Control Center downtime never blocks routing, hooks, agents, memory, context compilation, benchmark execution, or security scans.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-routecraft:orchestration to build this feature with adaptive routing, bounded memory recall, verification, reusable learning, and local effectiveness measurement when enabled.
Use RouteCraft to recall relevant prior decisions, choose the cheapest safe lane, implement this change, and verify the complete diff.
Use RouteCraft for this task; parallelize only independent work, add fresh Sol review only when risk warrants it, and preserve verified reusable decisions.
